correctness.rationale: Exact local CDF recursion is valid until the first image breakpoint because each map is monotone. The stopped martingale under original probabilities has zero contribution from never exiting; under the Cramér tilt a positive log drift forces exit and finite overshoot. Strictly positive H(δ) follows from forward invariance of stationary support and f_- orbit to zero/f_+ orbit to one. The tilted first-hitting identity gives uniform positive two-sided constants; layer cake proves finite iff s<κ and divergence at equality. The rational example has checked positive Lyapunov products and distinct κ sides of one.

value.rationale: Sharp endpoint local dimensions, simultaneous left/right slopes, and all inverse-moment thresholds are natural invariants for a non-atomic stationary law with common repelling boundary fixed points; previous literature offers only nonoptimal Hölder estimates and global dimensions. The theorem yields exact integrability criteria for singular observables and a concrete single-law example with divergent one-sided reciprocal moment but finite other-sided moment. This remains mathematically useful without an assertion about global mixing or exact density.
